input.rationale: No audit, inspection or verification right binding Sparkling exists anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for "audit", "inspect", "verify", "records", "premises" and "access" return nothing that gives Garman any right to audit our use of the Software; the use restrictions in § 3 (p0029–p0037) impose only self-executing covenants with no accompanying inspection mechanic, and § 20 General Matters contains no audit provision. The only examination right in the document (p0114, escrow materials: "Sparkling may itself or by retaining independent experts, examine and test the materials for compliance with the obligations of Garman hereunder") runs in our favour. The complete absence of any Garman audit right is better than the playbook's preferred position (once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, independent auditor, Vendor's cost, no system access), and no remote or unannounced access to our systems is granted, so there is no walk-away exposure. We therefore raise nothing and deliberately do not introduce audit language, since inserting a limited audit right would create a vendor entitlement we do not currently have.
